title: Understanding Zero-One Loss
text: The zero-one loss function is different from the cross-entropy loss because it considers both the model parameters and the threshold. Think about how changing the threshold might affect the classification results.

title: Precision and Zero-One Loss
text: Precision is a measure of how many of the predicted positive cases are actually positive. Consider how the threshold T affects precision and whether minimizing zero-one loss would necessarily maximize precision.

title: Evaluating Precision
text: If the threshold T is set too high, what happens to the precision of the model?
